sentences.scenario: Tell a colleague where you work.
sentences.source_note: Repeated correction of 工作在家 to 在家工作.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge yuè qù gōngsī liǎng cì.
sentences.english_hint: I go to the office twice a month.
sentences.source_note: Analysis confirms the learner's twice-monthly office visits.

sentences.chinese: 开车去公司要两个小时。
sentences.pinyin: Kāichē qù gōngsī yào liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
sentences.english_hint: Driving to the office takes two hours.
sentences.scenario: Explain how long your commute takes.
sentences.source_note: Analysis provides this extension from the learner's commute.

sentences.scenario: Describe your return trip from the office.
sentences.source_note: Corrected 开车去我的家; learner successfully repeated 开车回家.

sentences.scenario: Answer whether you prefer office work or working from home.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects the learner's attempt to express liking both options.

sentences.scenario: Explain what you do at the office.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 跟同事有会 to 跟同事开会.

sentences.english_hint: I'm allowed to work from home.
sentences.source_note: Analysis distinguishes intended permission from the restrictive 只能.

sentences.chinese: 有时候，我想跟别人说话。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu shíhou, wǒ xiǎng gēn biérén shuōhuà.
sentences.english_hint: Sometimes I want to talk to other people.
sentences.scenario: Explain why working from home can feel lonely.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 我想说人 and preserves the learner's reason for wanting office contact.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méi jiàn guo zhè ge zì.
sentences.scenario: Tell your Chinese teacher a character is unfamiliar.
sentences.source_note: Analysis distinguishes unfamiliarity from failing to see a character on one occasion.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méi kàndào Zhōngguó de chē.
sentences.english_hint: I didn't see any Chinese cars.
sentences.scenario: Describe what you did not see on an earlier trip.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects 不看 to 没看到 in the earlier travel discussion.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kāichē kāi de yǒudiǎn kuài.
sentences.english_hint: I drive a little too fast.
sentences.scenario: Describe your driving when you are alone.
sentences.source_note: Combines the analysis's 得 structure with the correction 一点快 to 有点快.

sentences.chinese: 有家人在车上，我就开得慢一点。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu jiārén zài chē shàng, wǒ jiù kāi de màn yìdiǎn.
sentences.english_hint: When family is in the car, I drive a little slower.
sentences.scenario: Explain how you drive with your family.
sentences.source_note: Analysis supplies this drill from the learner's contrast between solo and family driving.

sentences.chinese: 我的车被另一辆车撞了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de chē bèi lìng yí liàng chē zhuàng le.
sentences.english_hint: My car was hit by another car.
sentences.scenario: Explain what happened in your car accident.
sentences.source_note: Analysis gives this passive version of the learner's account and emphasizes retaining 撞.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jì bu qīng zhù le duō jiǔ.
sentences.english_hint: I don't remember clearly how long I stayed.
sentences.scenario: Answer a question about your childhood hospital stay.
sentences.source_note: Analysis emphasizes preserving uncertainty about the duration of childhood hospitalization.
